# WHY --no-logs, AND WHY THE STATUS IS CHECKED SEPARATELY
#
# Streaming the build log back CRASHES the Azure CLI on a Windows console.
# colorama writes the agent's output straight to the terminal in cp1252, pip
# emits a progress bar made of box-drawing characters, and the command dies:
#
#     UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode characters
#         in position 1794-1833: character maps to <undefined>
#
# The build had ALREADY SUCCEEDED in Azure when that happened. Measured
# 2026-10-23: `az acr task list-runs` reported Succeeded for a build whose
# command had exited 1, and the image was in the registry.
#
# So the script queues without streaming and then asks Azure what happened.
# The run status is the truth; the client exit code is not.
#
# Nothing is built on this machine. There is no Docker daemon in the loop,
# which is also why the build does not depend on what a laptop happens to
# have installed.
